variables.validatedFoundryResourceName: [if(and(and(and(not(contains(parameters('foundryResourceName'), '/')), not(contains(parameters('foundryResourceName'), ' '))), not(contains(parameters('foundryResourceName'), '?'))), not(contains(parameters('foundryResourceName'), '#'))), parameters('foundryResourceName'), fail('foundryResourceName must be safe for use as an Azure AI Services hostname.'))]
variables.validatedFoundryProjectName: [if(and(and(and(not(contains(parameters('foundryProjectName'), '/')), not(contains(parameters('foundryProjectName'), ' '))), not(contains(parameters('foundryProjectName'), '?'))), not(contains(parameters('foundryProjectName'), '#'))), parameters('foundryProjectName'), fail('foundryProjectName must be safe for use as an Activity endpoint path segment.'))]
variables.validatedHostedAgentName: [if(and(and(and(not(contains(parameters('hostedAgentName'), '/')), not(contains(parameters('hostedAgentName'), ' '))), not(contains(parameters('hostedAgentName'), '?'))), not(contains(parameters('hostedAgentName'), '#'))), parameters('hostedAgentName'), fail('hostedAgentName must be safe for use as an Activity endpoint path segment.'))]
variables.validatedAgentIdentityClientId: [if(and(and(and(equals(substring(parameters('agentIdentityClientId'), 8, 1), '-'), equals(substring(parameters('agentIdentityClientId'), 13, 1), '-')), equals(substring(parameters('agentIdentityClientId'), 18, 1), '-')), equals(substring(parameters('agentIdentityClientId'), 23, 1), '-')), parameters('agentIdentityClientId'), fail('agentIdentityClientId must have GUID shape.'))]
variables.validatedTenantId: [if(and(and(and(equals(substring(parameters('tenantId'), 8, 1), '-'), equals(substring(parameters('tenantId'), 13, 1), '-')), equals(substring(parameters('tenantId'), 18, 1), '-')), equals(substring(parameters('tenantId'), 23, 1), '-')), parameters('tenantId'), fail('tenantId must have GUID shape.'))]
variables.validatedLogAnalyticsWorkspaceResourceId: [if(and(startsWith(toLower(parameters('logAnalyticsWorkspaceResourceId')), '/subscriptions/'), contains(toLower(parameters('logAnalyticsWorkspaceResourceId')), '/providers/microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces/')), parameters('logAnalyticsWorkspaceResourceId'), fail('logAnalyticsWorkspaceResourceId must identify a Microsoft.OperationalInsights workspace.'))]
